metadata.title: Amana – Trusted Parcel Delivery by Travelers
metadata.description: Send your parcels with travelers going your way. Fast, affordable, and trusted.
metadata.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer parcel delivery by trusted travelers.

hero.description: Amana connects people who need to send parcels with travelers already heading to the destination. Cheaper, faster, and more personal than traditional couriers.

howItWorks.heading: How Amana works
howItWorks.subheading: Send your parcel in 4 simple steps. No hassle, no hidden fees.

steps.title: Find a Traveler
steps.desc: Search for verified travelers heading to your destination on your preferred date.

steps.title: Book & Pay Securely
steps.desc: Submit your parcel details and pay securely. Funds are held in escrow until delivery.

steps.title: Hand Off Your Parcel
steps.desc: Meet the traveler at the pickup point and hand over your parcel.

steps.title: Track & Receive
steps.desc: Track your parcel in real time. Payment is released to the traveler on delivery.

features.heading: Everything you need
features.subheading: Amana is built around trust, transparency, and simplicity.

items.title: ID Verified Users
items.desc: Every traveler and sender submits a government-issued ID. We verify before they can transact.

items.title: Secure Escrow Payments
items.desc: Your money is held safely and only released to the traveler after successful delivery.

items.title: Real-Time Tracking
items.desc: Track your parcel every step of the way with live status updates and photo proof on delivery.

items.title: Two-Way Reviews
items.desc: Both senders and travelers rate each other after every delivery. Trust is built over time.

items.title: Instant Notifications
items.desc: Get notified the moment your booking is accepted, your parcel is picked up, or delivered.

items.title: Up to 70% Cheaper
items.desc: Travelers set their own price. You get competitive rates far below traditional courier services.

items.name: Yasmine B.
items.text: I sent a 5kg package from Paris to Tunis for €18 instead of €80 with a traditional courier. The traveler was super professional and my parcel arrived in perfect condition!

items.name: Karim M.
items.text: I travel to Algeria every 2 months. With Amana I cover my luggage fees and even make a little extra. It's become a routine — I always check for parcels before flying.

items.name: Sarah L.
items.text: The escrow payment system gave me full confidence. I knew my money was safe until the delivery was confirmed. Highly recommend Amana!

items.name: Omar T.
items.text: The app is incredibly easy to use. I post my trip, accept requests, and everything is handled — payments, notifications, tracking. It just works.

downloadCTA.heading: Ready to send your first parcel?
downloadCTA.description: Join thousands of users already saving money and time with Amana. Start in minutes — no subscription needed.
